central_duty: Prioritize cyber defense of National Security Systems
Prioritize cyber defense of Department of War information systems
Expedite and prioritize cyber defense of civilian Federal Government information systems
Establish or expand Federal programs and cybersecurity services using AI-enabled defensive tools
Form an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse
Collaborate with the AI cybersecurity clearinghouse
Coordinate and deconflict software-vulnerability scanning
Discover and validate software vulnerabilities
Coordinate and prioritize remediation and distribution of vulnerability patches
Determine whether relevant Federal grant funding is available for advanced AI vulnerability detection
Expand United States Tech Force Information Cybersecurity Specialist hiring and placement pathways
Develop and maintain a classified process for benchmarking advanced cyber capabilities of AI models
Determine the threshold for designating an AI model as a covered frontier model
Make covered-frontier-model determinations in consultation with designated officials
Design a voluntary framework with AI developers
Engage the Federal Government to determine whether models under development meet the covered-frontier-model designation
Provide the Federal Government access to covered frontier models for up to 30 days before release to other trusted partners
Apply appropriate confidentiality, cybersecurity, insider-risk, intellectual-property, use, and nondisclosure protections
Collaborate to select trusted partners for early access to covered frontier models
Prioritize enforcement of applicable Federal criminal laws against criminal AI-enabled computer access or damage
Implement the order consistently with applicable law and available appropriations
Recognize that the order creates no privately enforceable substantive or procedural right or benefit
Must not allow a user to access, download, or use the service to nudify an image or video.
Must not nudify an image or video on behalf of a user.
Must not advertise or promote a service that performs prohibited nudification actions.
Subdivision 2 prohibitions do not apply when the service requires the technical skill of a user to nudify media.
May be sued by an individual depicted in unlawfully nudified media.
Subject to compensatory damages, including mental anguish or suffering, up to three times actual damages.
Subject to enforcement by the Minnesota Attorney General under section 8.31.
Subject to a civil penalty not exceeding $500,000 for each unlawful access, download, or use.
Civil penalties must be deposited in the general fund and annually appropriated for victim-service grants.
